SYMPTOM: Org tutors couldn't create availability slots (recurring or specific). Alert fired: 'Negalima kurti pamokų kol neprijungtas Stripe'
CAUSE: AvailabilityManager.tsx fetched only stripe_account_id from profiles to determine stripeConnected. Never fetched organization_id. Org tutors use manual payments and have no personal Stripe account.
FIX: Fetch organization_id alongside stripe_account_id in the Supabase query. Set stripeConnected = !!stripeId || !!organizationId — org tutors bypass the Stripe gate entirely.
PREVENT: Any new Stripe gate added to tutor actions must include an org tutor bypass using organization_id check
